## What changed?

## How was it checked?

List the relevant checks and results. For game changes, include the platform, GPU, renderer,
settings and scenes tested. For performance changes, compare the same scene and settings before
and after. For documentation changes, check the text and links.

## Remaining limits

Mention anything untested, known issues or follow-up work. Write "None" if there are none.
